WITH avg_q AS (
    SELECT l_partkey, avg(l_quantity) AS avg_q
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_partkey
)
SELECT sum(li.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 AS avg_yearly
FROM part p
JOIN avg_q a ON a.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN lineitem li ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#25'
  AND p.p_container = 'WRAP PACK'
  AND li.l_quantity < 0.2 * a.avg_q;

FROM customers c

) agg ON agg.customer_id = c.id
